summary: World Omni Auto Receivables LLC filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a securitization transaction. On July 29, 2026, the Issuing Entity, World Omni Select Auto Trust 2026-A, issued $615,190,000 of asset-backed notes across Classes A-1 through C. The Depositor purchased motor vehicle retail installment sale contracts from World Omni Financial Corp. and transferred them to the trust under a Sale and Servicing Agreement. The notes were issued pursuant to an Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company as trustee. This is a routine ABS issuance, not a special situation; no strategic event or unusual terms are involved.
